招待所里，气氛陷入了短暂的沉默，陈端抿没有想到刘济民拒绝的如此干脆利索。
对于陈端抿所谓批判的想法，刘济民不用细思就明白他到底想要干什么。
《中国青年》杂志此时复刊，本身就有其目的。通过《中国青年》杂志第一期发表的“科学和迷信”、“真理和谬误”等文章，就能看出端倪。
刘济民只想在《中国青年》杂志上谈谈青年人的事情，不想陷入漩涡之中。换句话说，《中国青年》杂志想要刘济民当刀是万万不可能的。
“济民同志，既然你态度如此坚定，我们就不强人所难了。你说得对，朝华是文艺复刊，是应该多强调强调文艺。”陈端抿抿了一口茶，微微一笑，算是将此事揭过了。
陈端抿收起稿子后，又对刘济民进行了简短的采访。问题涵盖了刘济民青年阶段的人生经历，从部队到入学，再到目前的新身份——军旅作家。
“济民同志，你的经历也够丰富的。从小见证了三门峡水利工程的发展，加入部队后，又因为救人立了二等功，再抓住上大学的机会走进大学。你觉得高考和推荐入学，哪种方式更为公平？”
“毫无疑问是高考，我虽然是工农兵学员，但对高考恢复也感到欣喜。”
陈端抿像是抓住了刘济民的漏洞，急忙追问道：“你在《光明日报》为工农兵大学生叫过屈？”
“我不希望陷入非黑即白的思维中，一味地去否定工农兵大学生。我认为在人才断层的年代，工农兵大学生成为各行业人才的有力补充，甚至很好地完成了任务。”
“就像你说的？他们来自基层，又回到了基层，补充了基层人才？”
“对，像我的室友学习完之后回去可以成为一名基层医生，但我相信许多高考生是不愿意回到公社医院工作的。”
陈端抿再次追问道：“77级大学生很多是下乡知青，他们也是来自基层。”
“陈大姐，你可以去采访一下77级学生。他们高考最大的动力就是逃离农村，费了这么大周折，你觉得他们会想回去吗？”
“但至少他们了解基层，学成之后，不会脱离现实去做工作。”
“我承认77级、78级的学生了解基层，他们在未来必然成为国家的黄金一代。但之后呢？‘知青’这个概念迟早会消失在历史的长河中。还有一个问题，您也说了，这次大学生许多是知青，这是因为知识青年基础和学习资源更好。未来随着发展，教育资源只会更加在城市倾斜。”

In the guest house, the atmosphere fell into a brief silence. Chen Duanqin did not expect Liu Jimin to refuse so simply and neatly.
As for Chen Duanqi's so-called critical thoughts, Liu Jimin didn't need to think carefully to understand what he wanted to do.
The resumption of publication of "China Youth" magazine at this time has its own purpose. Clues can be seen through articles such as "Science and Superstition" and "Truth and Falsehood" published in the first issue of "China Youth" magazine.
Liu Jimin just wanted to talk about young people's affairs in "China Youth" magazine, and did not want to get caught in the whirlpool. In other words, it is absolutely impossible for "China Youth" magazine to want Liu Jimin to be a swordsman.
"Comrade Jimin, since your attitude is so firm, we won't force others to make things difficult. You are right, Chaohua is a literary and art publication, and more emphasis should be placed on literature and art." Chen Duan took a sip of tea, smiled slightly, and dismissed the matter.
After Chen Duanqi put away the manuscript, he conducted a brief interview with Liu Jimin. The questions cover Liu Jimin’s life experience in his youth, from the army to schooling, to his current new identity as a military writer.
"Comrade Jimin, you have rich experience. You have witnessed the development of the Sanmenxia Water Conservancy Project since you were a child. After joining the army, you made second-class merit for saving people, and then you seized the opportunity to go to university. Which method do you think is more fair, the college entrance examination or recommended admission?"
"There is no doubt that it is the college entrance examination. Although I am a worker, peasant, and soldier student, I am also happy that the college entrance examination has resumed."
Chen Duanqin seemed to have caught Liu Jimin's loophole and hurriedly asked: "Are you complaining about the injustice of workers, peasants and soldiers college students in Guangming Daily?"
"I don't want to fall into black-and-white thinking and blindly deny worker, peasant, and soldier college students. I believe that in an era of talent gaps, worker, peasant, and soldier college students have become a powerful complement to talents in various industries, and they have even completed their tasks well."
"Like you said? They came from the grassroots and returned to the grassroots to supplement the talents at the grassroots?"
"Yes, my roommate can become a grassroots doctor after studying, but I believe that many college entrance examination students are unwilling to return to work in commune hospitals."
Chen Duanqi asked again: "Many college students in the 1977 class are educated youth who went to the countryside. They are also from the grassroots."
"Sister Chen, you can go interview the 77-level students. Their biggest motivation for the college entrance examination is to escape from the countryside. After going through so much trouble, do you think they will want to go back?"
"But at least they understand the grassroots level, and after completing their studies, they will not be divorced from reality to do their work."
"I admit that the students in the Class of 1977 and Class of 1978 understand the grassroots, and they will definitely become the country's golden generation in the future. But what happens after that? Sooner or later, the concept of 'educated youth' will disappear in the long river of history. There is another problem. You also said that many college students this time are educated youth. This is because the foundation and learning resources of educated youth are better. With development in the future, educational resources will only be more tilted in cities."
